stem: What was the main effect of the changes shown in this graph on the western United States?

options.label: F
options.text: Immigration from Europe to western U.S. cities increased rapidly.

options.label: G
options.text: Western U.S. businesses traded more efficiently with the East Coast and Europe.

options.label: H
options.text: Asian businesses bypassed the West Coast to trade directly with the East Coast.

options.label: J
options.text: Western states recruited guest workers from the Caribbean and South America.
